# Generated files

Nothing here is written by hand. JSON cannot carry a comment, so this page says it instead.

| File | Made from | Command |
|---|---|---|
| [`facts.json`](facts.json) | [`../ggg.did`](../ggg.did) | `npm run facts` in [`../conformance`](../conformance) |

The conformance suite fails when a file here differs from what the command produces, so a change
belongs in the source, never here.
